law_quoted.envelope_section_6: Absolute Horizon is not stratum 10, not a synonym for religion, and not a demographic variable. It is the evolving relation to what is ultimately binding: the horizon within which finite strata can be absolutized, relativized, judged, mourned, refused, reconciled or transformed. WHERE GOVERNED UPSTREAM MATERIAL BEARS ON ABSOLUTE HORIZON, the downstream chain must preserve its distinct semantic status and its relations to finite strata without reducing it to biography, religiosity, ideology score, or static identity. V3/V2 later realize lived orientation/expression. V553-V558 must preserve the lawful structural/horizon prerequisites and constraints without manufacturing actor belief.
law_quoted.envelope_q6: If Horizon-relevant governed material exists, is its distinct status preserved rather than flattened into finite-stratum or religiosity semantics?
law_quoted.td_r03_section_11: Absolute Horizon remains separate from all nine finite strata. V556 preserves only explicit upstream AH authority; it never infers AH from religion, ideology, survey wording, route/channel type, contradiction or attractor topology.
law_quoted.ruling_section_7: Absolute Horizon remains distinct from all nine finite strata and generic Horizon context. Preserve only explicit governed AH authority; never infer AH from religion, ideology, route/channel, contradiction or topology.
law_quoted.crosswalk_section_4: Do not restore the nine fixed strata as mandatory current ontology. HISTORICAL_NINE_STRATA = DESIGN_REQUIREMENTS_ANCESTRY.
